note: The well spliced: every floor's opening is cut differently, so floors overhang and step back; turquoise light at the bottom
From a raised terrace in one corner: an arcade on one side only, the spiral stair in the far corner
Two floors down: a bridge on this floor only, and water spilling down one face of the shaft
From the pool at the bottom: the openings above do not line up
From the Level 0 corridor: the tiled arch frames the beach, the terrace and the channel beyond
On the dry landing: the floor runs down into the water; the terrace, the bridge, the island and the dome are at other heights
From the terrace: the bridge to the island, the weir beyond, the gallery and the spiral against the far wall
From the gallery: the whole route below, every part at its own level
On the island under the dome: the oculus is the only source you can see
The slide tower: two turns of spiral stair to a platform at +6 m, the tube crossing the hall and leaving through the wall
From the platform: the tube drops toward a hole in the far wall; the catch pool is behind it
Wading in the catch pool: the tube arrives through the wall from a room you have not seen
The casbah cluster: blocks start from their own levels (0, +0.3, +0.6, +1.2, +1.8, +2.4, +3.0 m), joined by stairs and a stair-bridge; the lowest level is flooded
From the highest block: arched gates on the blocks, stairs running into the water
Wading on the flooded level: the stair-bridge overhead
Level 0, a 1980s computer room: raised floor +0.30 m with its 1:12 ramp and a two-riser step; the ceiling stays, so the room gets lower
Level 0, a tiered training room: you enter at the top and the floor steps down 1.35 m in tiers of 0.45; aisle steps at one side
Level 0, a sunken lounge: a pit 0.6 m down with steps on two sides, off the room's centre
Level 0, a split-level suite in a 5.4 m room: a platform at +1.2, a gallery at +2.7; the spiral is one way up, the flight along the wall the other
From the gallery: the platform and the main floor below, the spiral in the corner
Office, a raised trading floor (+0.30 m, ramp and steps) with low 1.35 m panels: from it you see over the field to the Relay on the lower floor
Office, a file mezzanine at +2.7 m in a 5.4 m room: a spiral at one end, a straight flight at the other (two ways up)
From the mezzanine: the cubicle field below at 1.65 m panels
Run!: three risers up through a fire-door frame, a ramp back down at the next, and the bright dock beyond: the release
On the dock platform at corridor level: the bay drops 1.22 m to the truck floor; the half-open roll-up door is the brightest thing
A threshold: the floor steps up 0.45 m through the frame while the soffit stays, so the corridor gets lower
